title: Ops activation roadmap & collab rituals
content:
Purpose:
This is a working plan for activating a cross-functional reliability program focused on a set of pragmatic SLO pilots. The doc captures the 90-day tactical roadmap, recurring rituals (meetings and checkpoints), owner matrix, gating criteria for pilots, and a short checklist for embedding runbooks and dashboards into team workflows. This is not final — meant to be a lightweight playbook the first teams can adopt and adapt.

Context / why now:
- Multiple product teams have reported intermittent latency spikes and error regressions after model rollouts.
- We need a repeatable, low-friction approach to define SLIs/SLOs, run controlled experiments, and hand off remediation flows to feature teams.
- Goal: pilot across 2 product areas (Hosted API + Dedicated capacity) to validate instrumentation, alerting, and on-call choreography.

90-day tactical roadmap (high level):
- Week 0-2: Discovery and SLI definition sprint (workshops with product, infra, runtime teams).
- Week 3-5: Instrumentation gap fixes and dashboard templates (observability team + infra).
- Week 6-9: Canary pilot runs (small % traffic, blue/green for model variants) with explicit SLO targets and rollback rules.
- Week 10-12: Evaluation window, quality/regression checks, cost/perf analysis, decision: scale/pause/iterate.

Milestones & acceptance gates:
- Milestone A (end W2): Shared SLI spec and test queries for each pilot service (latency buckets, error types, availability). Gate: product + SRE sign-off.
- Milestone B (end W5): Dashboards (per-route latency, token-level cost, request sampling) + automated SLI calculators live. Gate: >= 95% of traffic paths instrumented for sampling.
- Milestone C (end W9): Successful canary with no SLO breach for 48h under defined load. Gate: no more than 10% degradation in quality metrics and rollback automation validated.
- Milestone D (end W12): Pilot retrospective and handoff doc; decision recorded (scale, iterate, or pause).

Roles & owner matrix (one-line entries):
- Program lead: Ethan Rivera — overall timeline, cross-team coordination, exec updates.
- Technical lead (observability): Luca Bianchi — dashboard templates, SLI math, instrumentation PRs.
- Runtime lead: Priya Shah — model-serving changes, canary config, fallback hooks.
- Product partner (Hosted API): Tamika Osei — product acceptance criteria, user-facing risk, test prompts.
- Incident liaison: Maya Gonzalez — runbook authoring, postmortem facilitation.
- SRE oncall partner: rotation TBD — validate alert noise and on-call playbooks.

Initial SLO candidates (per-service, examples):
- Request latency: p95 < 300ms for short prompt path (<= 512 tokens) with error budget 99.5% success window.
- Token stream health: streaming connection drop rate < 0.2% per hour.
- Inference error rate: 5xx or model-timeout <= 0.1% per 1000 requests.
- Availability: 99.9% per week for dedicated pools under normal load.

SLI instrumentation checklist (quick):
- Add request-id header propagation across runtime stacks.
- Emit sampling traces for 1% of requests with full payloads (privacy-scrubbed).
- Centralize 4xx/5xx taxonomy in infra logs.
- Publish token-level billing metrics to cost stream.

Rituals & cadence (recommended):
- Weekly pilot sync (30m): status, blockers, next actions — mandatory for owners.
- Twice-weekly observability deep-dive (45m during W3-W6): dashboard reviews, query tuning.
- Pre-canary safety review (live meeting, 60m): all owners present, runbook walkthrough, rollback drill.
- Post-canary standdown (30m): quick health check and retention decision.
- Retro + decision board (60m at end of W12): collect tickets, lessons, handoff tasks.

Runbooks & playbooks to deliver:
- Canary rollback playbook: steps, owners, checklists (automated rollback + manual fallback).
- Incident play: SLO breach > 10% for 30 minutes — safety ladder and comms template.
- Observability ops: how to add SLI, update dashboard, and decommission sample points.

Measurement & dashboards (must-haves):
- Per-route SLO panel: p50/p90/p95 latency, error rate, traffic volume.
- SLO burn rate: 1h, 6h, 24h windows with alert thresholds.
- Quality regressions: prompt-based quality suite pass rate and model output drift stats.
- Cost signal: token cost per 1000 requests and per-route breakdown.

Escalation & comms plan:
- On-call page: immediate triage -> SREPager -> Program lead if not resolved in 30m.
- Slack channels: #sre-pilot-hosted, #sre-pilot-dedicated for operational chatter.
- Exec cadence: biweekly one-slide update for leadership (latency, cost, incidents, ask).

Pilot evaluation rubric (decision criteria):
- Scale if: no SLO violation for 7 days at pilot traffic, runbook validated, cost delta < 15% and quality metrics within threshold.
- Iterate if: instrumentation gaps or intermittent breaches tied to specific conditions; plan defined and reschedule.
- Pause/rollback if: repeated SLO failures, unacceptably degraded quality, or automated rollback triggers.

Open questions / risks (to resolve early):
- Which exact token cost model to use for per-route accounting (billing vs estimated)? Owner: Finance eng contact.
- Sampling privacy: where to scrub user data in sampled payloads? Owner: Security.
- Cross-region fallbacks: acceptable latency tradeoffs for geo routing? Owner: Platform eng.

Short checklist for handoff to product teams (when ready to scale):
- SLI/SLO spec doc committed and linked in team Confluence.
- Dashboards stable and annotated (owner + metric explanations).
- Runbooks published and can be executed by on-call with <= 15m prep.
- Post-pilot retro completed and actions assigned.
- Release checklist passed with QA prompts and cost signoff.

Notes to self / TODOs:
- Add template for SLI spec that includes sampling plan and retention window. — Luca
- Block out pre-canary safety review on W6 calendar and invite exec observer slot. — Ethan
- Create a short playbook for customer-communication templates if a visible degradation occurs. — Tamika

Appendix: quick links and refs (working):
- SLI/SLO working template: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SRE/SLI+Template
- Canary automation repo: github.com/redwood-inference/canary-orchestration (PR#78)
notes: Working doc intended for the SRE + product partners. Keep lean; prefer checklists and clear owners. Will iterate after first pilot cycle.
